method: captured from the live rendered grid on 2026-08-07 via raw CDP through the operator's Chrome after logging into Taobao (Playwright's connect_over_cdp handshake is incompatible with Chrome 151; plain CDP over websockets works); three tiles whose anchors are item.taobao.com links, trimmed only of image src/data-src values and svg bodies — title nodes, price parts, shop/sales/location nodes verbatim; tiles linking to detail.tmall.com are not extractable by design and stay out; the full raw page stays outside git in .agent/captures/taobao_search_page_raw.html
